page.title: Template Variables Documentation
page.subtitle: Complete guide of all available variables for use in message and email templates

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Template variables allow you to personalize messages and emails with dynamic information. Use the format {VariableName} in your templates and the system will automatically replace it with the corresponding value.

usage.title: How to Use
usage.step1: 1. Write your message or email normally
usage.step2: 2. Where you want to insert dynamic information, use the format {VariableName}
usage.step3: 3. The system will automatically replace the variable with the corresponding value when the message is sent

bestPractices.title: Best Practices
bestPractices.tip1: • Always use curly braces {} around the variable name
bestPractices.tip3: • If a variable is not available, the literal text {VariableName} will be displayed
bestPractices.tip4: • Combine multiple variables in the same message for greater personalization
